description: How safe is this car in a crash? Returns the US NCAP 5-Star Safety Ratings for a make, model and model year, one entry per body style or drivetrain: overall, frontal (driver and passenger), side barrier and side pole, and rollover stars with the rollover risk percentage. For family car buyers comparing models. Source: NHTSA NCAP. These are US tests; Euro NCAP scores for UK-market cars are separate and not comparable star for star. (cost: 1 credit)

make.description: string, required, vehicle make, e.g. honda

model.description: string, required, US model name, e.g. accord

name: vehicle_crash_ratings
